title: Saving an edit shows the new name and Due text in the row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 10 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Choose a new name for term A that no term has; call the new name term B.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace the Name with the name of term B.
  4. Click the Day box.
  5. Type 15 in the Day box.
  6. Click "Save Changes".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Edit Credit Term" window opens.

Step 3:

  • The Name reads term B.

Step 4:

  • "Due day of the following month" is chosen and Days is emptied.

Step 5:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 6:

  • The window closes, the green toast "term B saved" shows, and the row now reads term B with Due "15th of the following month", listed after the Net terms.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R8: “On Save Changes, the window closes, a success toast shows "{name} saved", and the row shows the new name and Due text.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit term edited and saved | "{name} saved" | Success toast”
  • Story 3, Error Handling: “On Create, a success toast shows "{name} created". On Save Changes, a success toast shows "{name} saved". Both are the same green toast as the page's other actions.”
